Acupuncture has been shown to be effective in improving vocal function and healing of vocal fold lesions, particularly when used as part of a comprehensive treatment plan. This suggests that acupuncture may be a useful adjunctive therapy for individuals with phonotraumatic vocal pathologies.

It is essential to note that while acupuncture shows promise, more research is needed to fully understand its efficacy and optimal use in treating phonotraumatic vocal pathologies. As such, it is not recommended as the sole treatment option without consulting a healthcare professional.
